notes.title: New Game Released!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

I'm excited to announce that I've just released my latest game, [b]Loot Express Delivery Service[/b]! It's a 2D pixel art game where you take on the role of a commander, tasked with retrieving valuable items from a distant planet. With challenging missions and a focus on strategy, you'll guide your company to prosperity.

If you enjoyed my previous game, I invite you to check out [b]Loot Express Delivery Service[/b]. It's a great opportunity to experience a new adventure and see how my game development skills have progressed.

Thank you for your continued support, and I hope you enjoy [b]Loot Express Delivery Service[/b] as much as I enjoyed creating it!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2082620/Loot_Express_Delivery_Service/]Steam Store Page to Loot Express Delivery Service[/url]

notes.title: helium electric is now available
notes.notes:
You are one of the candidates selected by [b]helium electric[/b] to man a moon station.
Achieve a high helium-3 harvesting rate and you will have a secure future for you and your family. 
Remember, you are responsible for the best equipment that 1986 has to offer.

Your family and friends are counting on you.
We assume that you will do everything possible not to disappoint us.

So let's get started.
